title: Long grass
description: One overgrown yellow-green grass clump for a 0.5 m yard cell: four tall leaning tufts, eight loose blades flopping out, and four thin stems with pale seed heads. A single mesh node `crop` (materials crop + head), instanced.
checks: 3/4 tile: a wild, untidy yellow-green clump, clearly taller and shaggier than a lawn tuft
FRONT tile: pale seed heads on thin stems reach the top of the box (0.6 m), every blade starts on the grid line
TOP tile: the clump stays inside the 0.5 m cell
